# Changes Log / 更新日志

- Upgrade ZeroTier core to 1.16.2
  - :bulb: 05bc097 Update ZeroTier core to 1.16.2
- Stability fixes
  - :hammer: 0e3a520 Fix APP crash when receiving ICMPv6 NS frames (#81)
  - :hammer: b481035 Fix infinite loop caused by wrong `/proc/net/igmp` parsing (#74)
  - :hammer: b1113dd Enable core library desugaring to add missing NIO APIs on old devices (#79)
- Build maintenance
  - :hammer: 7090c83 Fix fastlane error in build action (#89)
  - :hammer: 0373a58 Fix APK signing failure in build action (thanks @sffxzzp)

- 升级 ZeroTier 核心至 1.16.2
  - :bulb: 05bc097 更新 ZeroTier 核心至 1.16.2
- 稳定性修复
  - :hammer: 0e3a520 修复接收 ICMPv6 NS 帧时 APP 崩溃的问题 (#81)
  - :hammer: b481035 修复因 `/proc/net/igmp` 解析错误导致的死循环，同时修复 #74
  - :hammer: b1113dd 启用 core library desugaring，补齐旧设备缺失的 NIO API (#79)
- 构建流程维护
  - :hammer: 7090c83 修复构建流程中的 fastlane 报错 (#89)
  - :hammer: 0373a58 修复构建流程中的 APK 签名失败（感谢 @sffxzzp）

# Notification / 一些说明

- This release upgrades the bundled ZeroTier core to 1.16.2. The APP version now includes the core version, e.g. `1.0.11+core.1.16.2`.
- `versionCode` has been increased to 16, so this build can be installed over previous releases.

- 本次更新将内置的 ZeroTier 核心升级至 1.16.2。APP 版本号现已包含核心版本，例如 `1.0.11+core.1.16.2`。
- `versionCode` 已递增至 16，可直接覆盖安装旧版本。
